name: sonz-ai
description: Sonzai SDK skills for AI coding agents. Wizard-driven builds, autonomous closed-loop builds, and an internal-staff dogfooding companion.

plugins.name: sonzai-sdk
plugins.description: Wizard + autonomous builder for the Sonzai SDK. Prescribes archetype, memory mode, runtime mode (full-chat vs memory-layer), BYOK posture, and capabilities — then drives spec → review → plan. full-auto runs the same pipeline closed-loop from a meeting transcript with API + UI verification.

plugins.name: sonzai-internal-staff
plugins.description: Internal-only companion plugin to sonzai-sdk. Adds monolith + workspace awareness for Sonzai staff dogfooding. Requires read access to the private sonzai-ai-monolith-ts repo — useless to external users; do not install unless you are Sonzai internal staff.
